name: Apple Education Store
summary: Education pricing on Mac, iPad and more, plus up to 10% off AppleCare+.
key: Education savings on Mac and iPad, and up to 10% off AppleCare+ for a new Mac or iPad.
who: Full-time or part-time students aged 18 or over, studying at or accepted into an accredited Australian university or another Apple-approved institution.
Parents buying for a student at an eligible institution, and university lecturers and staff.
how: Shop through the Apple Education Store and complete verification.
catches: Limits apply across every channel, online and in store.
Purchases must be for your own personal, education or research use. Apple can ask for proof and cancel orders that don't qualify.
Online orders ship only within Australia.
Prices aren't shown here because they change often. Compare with the regular store before you buy.
